skip_tensor_list_with_mask: apply a boolean mask to filter a list of PyTorch tensors by selected indices
skip_single_tensor_with_mask: apply a boolean mask to filter a single PyTorch tensor by selected indices
expand_tensor_to_target_dim: expand a 2D or 3D tensor along dimension 1 by padding with a specified index value
coalesce_optional_tensor: return the first tensor if not None otherwise return the fallback tensor
fill_tensor_at_masked_positions: fill tensor x with values from tensor y at masked positions using a padding index
